column1: # Partition table — mirrors the STOCK SenseCAP Watcher layout exactly.
# This is not the layout from the SDK examples
# stock device keeps its provisioned identity (EUI
# `nvsfactory` at 0x9000. The SDK example table has no such partition and puts a
# plain `nvs` at 0x9000 instead — flashing that would place a writable NVS on
# top of the factory data and destroy the device's identity the first time
# anything wrote to it. Seeed's own docs warn about exactly this.
# Keeping the stock geometry also means our app partition lines up with theirs
# so the factory firmware in the other OTA slot stays valid as a fallback.
